validation.mesh_style: Equal-width long horizontal traces use equal transverse offsets and thirds-rule edge cells. Actual CAD copper is unchanged.

predeclared_review_targets.purpose: Routing comparison of the three actual CADs, not Ethernet certification or a measured fabrication tolerance.
interpretation: These are engineering numerical-review targets selected for this comparison, not a published Ethernet pass/fail limit.
Also inspect complex residual amplitudes, source-basis conditioning, termination residuals and passivity.
Do not infer a unique ranking when the compared grid responses cross or overlap at the frequency being discussed.
No values are replaced by fitted or idealized values to satisfy these targets.
Reject the original uniform-grid ranking because equal-width long conductors received unequal transverse discretization. Preserve those records as diagnostic trials only.

validation.interpretation: Observed discretization and record-window sensitivities, not statistical error bounds. Acceptance requires review of complex changes, band-wise ranking and physical scope.

review_outcome.outcome: Reviewed for comparative reporting with explicit numerical exceptions
supported_findings: Revision01 has the smallest differential reflection for both pairs in both reviewed grids throughout1-150MHz.
Revision01 has the smallest A-pair differential-to-common conversion in both reviewed grids throughout1-150MHz.
Revision02 to03 reduces differential-to-common conversion for both pairs in both reviewed grids throughout1-150MHz.
limits: Revision01 B-pair conversion is not numerically converged; its low-frequency ranking is not established, and its very low fine-grid absolute value must not be presented as confirmed.
Some reflection changes exceed the1dB numerical review target. Their actual values and current-frequency changes remain visible.
The small B-pair reflection difference between02 and03 overlaps their two-grid value ranges; do not claim a decisive reflection advantage between them.
Actual CAD revisions change width, layer transitions, connector position and nearby copper as well as length. This does not isolate a skew-only causal contribution.
The two grids and record windows are sensitivity observations, not statistical uncertainty limits.

exclusions: Manufacturing tolerances and measured material properties
metric_convention: Sdd11 and Scd21 are 20log10(abs(S)), negative is smaller. Insertion loss is -20log10(abs(Sdd21)).
